hooks.name: Sync Memory on Agent Stop
hooks.description: At the end of a turn, judge whether meaningful work occurred and update project memory if so. The procedure lives in .kiro/steering/memory.md; this hook only triggers it.

action.prompt:
Apply the memory protocol in `.kiro/steering/memory.md` to the turn that just ended.

Judge first, using that file's 'When to update' rule. If no meaningful work occurred, do nothing and say so in one line — an empty update is correct.

If meaningful work did occur, follow 'How to update' and 'What goes where' exactly. Do not restate the protocol back; just execute it.
